annotations.title: Add fillable form fields to a PDF

description: Add fillable form fields (AcroForm) to an existing PDF at exact positions, or (detect true) find them on a flat PDF automatically: text, multiline text, checkbox, radio group, dropdown and signature box. Coordinates are PDF points measured from the bottom-left corner of the page as the viewer sees it (1 inch = 72 pt; US Letter is 612 x 792), the same frame and 1-based page numbers as pdf_edit; x and y are the field's bottom-left corner and the whole rectangle must lie inside the page (each side at least 4 pt). Every entry needs type, name and page; every type except radio also needs x, y, width and height; radio and dropdown need options. Unknown keys are rejected. The signature type creates an EMPTY signature field for a signing tool to use: nothing is signed, it is not an e-signature. At most 200 entries and 200 widgets per call, and 2,000 fields in the finished form. Fields are plain AcroForm with no JavaScript. pdf_fill fills the result and pdf_inspect lists the new fields. For a flat PDF, pdf_detect_fields returns suggested fields that can be passed as fields; detect true does both steps in one call. Returns the PDF inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified.

detect.description: Instead of fields: detect the blanks drawn on a flat PDF (lines, boxes, underscores, checkboxes) and add a text or checkbox field for each, in one request. The answer reports how many fields were added; pdf_detect_fields returns the suggestions for review first. pages, max_pages and min_confidence apply as in pdf_detect_fields. Cannot be combined with fields. Default false.

fields.description: Fields to create. Required unless detect is true. Nothing is added unless every entry is valid. Required keys: every entry type, name, page; text, checkbox, dropdown and signature also x, y, width, height; radio and dropdown also options (radio options carry their own rectangles).

background.description: Paint an opaque white background. Default false (none).

border.description: Draw a black 1 pt outline. Default true.

checked.description: Checkbox only: start ticked. Default false.

confidence.description: Ignored. Lets an entry from pdf_detect_fields be passed as it is.

default.description: Text, radio (one option value) or dropdown (one option): the starting value. Defaults and dropdown options use standard fonts (WinAnsi characters only: euro sign and curly quotes work, Polish L-stroke and CJK fail).

font_size.description: Text and dropdown: points (1-200), or "auto" (size chosen at the first fill, then kept). Omitted: a fixed min(12, largest size that fits one line in the height), at least 4. "auto" stores size 0 and pdf_fill then sizes the text to the box when the blank field is first filled (a short value is enlarged, a long one shrunk) and keeps that size, so a later, longer value is clipped; a fixed size draws predictably, and a value longer than the box is clipped, not shrunk.

height.description: Height in points. Not used by radio.

label.description: Ignored. Lets an entry from pdf_detect_fields be passed as it is.

multiline.description: Text only: allow several lines. Default false.

name.description: Field name: 1-200 characters, no dot, unique in the request and not already a field name in the PDF (a name equal to the first part of an existing dotted name is also taken).

options.description: Dropdown: strings. Radio: objects with value, x, y, width and height.

value.description: Option value, unique in the group, not "Off".

read_only.description: Set the field's ReadOnly flag. Default false.

required.description: Set the field's Required flag. Default false.

width.description: Width in points. Not used by radio.

x.description: Left edge in points from the page's left. Not used by radio.

y.description: Bottom edge in points from the page's bottom. Not used by radio.

max_pages.description: With detect: analyse at most this many pages. Default 40.

min_confidence.description: With detect: drop fields below this confidence. Default 0.4.

pages.description: With detect: pages to analyse, "1-3,5,8-". Default all.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

name: pdf_add_fields

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

detect_truncated.description: With detect: the answer is incomplete (more than 200 fields, more than max_pages pages, or the call stopped at its limit); a further call on the returned PDF with detect true and pages set to next_pages covers the rest; the answer is complete when this is absent

fields_detected.description: With detect: how many fields were detected and added (0 leaves the PDF unchanged)

next_pages.description: With detect: pages not done (page spec, including a page cut at 200 fields); a further call on the returned PDF with detect true and pages set to this value covers them

note.description: With detect and no fields found

pages_skipped.description: With detect: pages not analysed because they hold more drawn shapes or text than the per-page limits

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

warning.description: Present as xfa-layer-dropped when a hybrid AcroForm/XFA input lost its XFA layer
